card.name: Comma after a condition phrase
card.fires_on: Punctuation or a small linking word that closes an opening condition or category phrase, such as a comma after 'For patients on a single opioid' or 'If the grade ... are the same'. The next words give the instruction for that case.

modes.description: A comma ends an 'if/for/in the case of' phrase and the instruction follows.
